idea-plugin.name: Clotr
idea-plugin.description:
Clotr flags credentials in open files as you edit and shows a masked preview for each finding. Credential checks are on by default. Checks for personal details in open files start off and can be turned on in settings.

Use Check my clipboard or Check selection before sharing text. Clotr checks up to 1 MB of text and can copy a cleaned version with Bandage placeholders.

Set up Clotr Guard from Tools or Clotr settings when you want to check prompts and file reads in Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI or Windsurf. Guard setup needs Node.js, previews its changes and waits for your approval.

The plugin runs in the IDE and makes no network calls. It reads .clotrignore at the repository root. Secret files stay silent in the editor. If Git does not ignore a secret file, Clotr shows one project note with an option to add it to .gitignore.

Free and open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Source and issues.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Clotr now recognizes access tokens for Open VSX, RubyGems and JetBrains Marketplace.
  • Changing Clotr's settings rechecks open files right away, so their warnings and the status bar count follow your choice.
  • Add to .gitignore now handles special characters in file paths, and won't write through a link or to anything that isn't a normal file.
  • A large or unusual .gitignore can no longer slow the editor down.
  • Credential checks start on and personal-detail checks start off. Guard setup is still a separate step you choose.
